name: flauz-integrity
description: Flauz signing and integrity plane (A-PROD-005-W2): the detached-signature ledger over the pinned bundle artifacts (flauz.integrity.sign: reads build/flauz/security/bundle-manifest.json -- every pinned artifact's sha256 -- re-derives each artifact's hash LIVE over the real bytes, never trusting the manifest's value, then produces one ed25519 detached signature per artifact through the injected KeyPort; the ledger record binds artifact path + re-derived sha256 + algorithm id + key fingerprint + signature + clock-port timestamp, signs ITSELF (self-hash + self-signature -- the tamper-evident chain), persists workspace-locally + banks census-visible; the key posture is the DISCLOSED local-dev posture: a workspace-local ed25519 keypair generated on first sign, private key confined to the workspace-local key store owned by the port, never committed, never banked, never rendered -- production signing keys are the operator's, held outside the product; this extension proves the VERIFICATION machinery, not key custody), the one-command integrity verdict (flauz.integrity.verify: per pinned artifact -- re-hash the bytes, compare against the manifest pin (tamper signal), verify the ledger signature against the ledger's recorded public key (authenticity), check ledger coverage; the typed verdict table green/tampered/unsigned/torn per artifact + the ledger-chain row; absent key store / absent ledger = typed degradation, the record persists, never a silent green), and the read-only state view (flauz.integrity.status: pinned count, signed coverage, key fingerprint, last verify verdict summary -- rendered, no state change).

commands.title: Integrity: Sign Pinned Bundle Artifacts (Detached Signature Ledger)
